notes.title: "Star Leaping Story" at a New Lowest Price + All-New Version!
notes.content:
The Steam Summer Sale has officially begun, and "Star Leaping Story" is now available at its lowest price ever! Thank you for your support!

At the same time, a new version and a music album have also arrived!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2971560/Star_Leaping_Story_Soundtrack/

Please refer to the following updates:

1. Added an easier difficulty mode for newcomers and a challenging hard mode for veterans.
2. The default experience is set to normal mode.
3. Various bug fixes and experience updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185854/7c183f9258e843aa03017ea20c665e960bb23d4b.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: "Starry Leap Story" has finally been officially released today!
notes.content:
Developed solely by independent game developer ZerovHao, the pixel art platformer "Starry Leap Story," which garnered praise from players at various gaming expos, is officially launching on Steam today!

In the latest official version, in addition to various optimizations and bug fixes, a significant feature is the full Japanese voice acting! With captivating performances from renowned voice actors, the story's immersion and emotional impact are notably enhanced! Whether it's the fast-paced exhilarating dashes or the joyful banter in the story's small theaters, "Starry Leap Story" offers a multifaceted experience of joy, excitement, and emotion.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184010/_/

Rich levels, professional voice acting, and an engaging and touching story. Get it now during the first week with a 10% discount - it's the perfect time to dive in!

[h2]renowned voice actors[/h2]

During last year's demo showcase at the Tokyo Game Show, the game caught the attention of the Japanese company BraveHearts Studio and established a connection with them. As a result, professional voice actors were invited to participate in the game's creation. Led by four renowned voice actors known for their roles in multiple classic anime, manga, and game works, along with many other professional voice actors contributing their voices, the game offers exceptional auditory enjoyment. This collaboration has elevated the characters and the entire story to a new level of excellence!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185854/9d085a8112392362c7d6f96bc2d04d6e7bfb2e8f.png[/img]

[h2] Touching Story[/h2]

A space exploration team is on its way back to their home planet when their spaceship experiences a critical malfunction and crash-lands on a mysterious planet. Despite its seemingly lively and cheerful appearance, the planet harbors unexplained dangers. A young girl awakens from a shattered underground laboratory and subsequently encounters peculiar creatures. Together, they embark on an adventure to return to their home planet and uncover the truth behind the events.

- A light-hearted and enjoyable plot atmosphere with suspenseful developments.
- Contains meme elements.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185854/ce1df447d40a40067f9c8dcc77f1ae714c1ced07.png[/img]

[h2]Unique Dash System[/h2]


When the character jumps and is in mid-air, pressing the jump button again will activate a state where the character stops in mid-air.
From there, you can dash in four directions - up, down, left, or right. Timing the dashes correctly and managing the distance and key presses is crucial to successfully navigating through the levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185854/c75c161e99c08f7f53a7bd256ffd895828cb0ebd.gif[/img]

[h2]Rich level environments[/h2]

From the trap-filled underground research facility to the intricately structured Sky Tower, and further into the perilous cosmic space with gravity challenges. Throughout the game, you'll encounter new level mechanics such as blocks that bounce characters, or special items like the Soul Light that restores dash charges. By becoming familiar with these mechanics and practicing repeatedly, you'll become stronger and more skilled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185854/b2b9716cc86e779683638b48f82e668624d0097b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185854/3386982f07a3348b8bbc07612b476ad9be57028a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Developed by a single person.[/h2]
Created full-time over the course of two years, everything from programming, art, music, to storyline and cutscene performances were independently crafted. Inspired by beloved independent games, the goal was to create a game that brings joy and emotions to everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185854/97c3287655b26f76974e8ad9e19f4cbc5d78b123.png[/img]

notes.title: Star Leaping Story:prologue" is now officially launched. Go experience it now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936407/d5837154abe099d6b93daa0d905870dea93100f3.png[/img]

The 2D precision platformer game "Star Leaping Story: Prologue" is now officially released! This title serves as a free playable prologue version of "Star Leaping Story," and we are very excited for everyone to play it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2877340/


The game tells the story of a mysterious white-robed girl embarking on a wonderful adventure, where she encounters various exotic creatures. By combining abilities with her companions, she overcomes numerous challenges and ultimately discovers what truth lies ahead.

The prologue version will include the following elements:

[list]
[*] About 1 hour of adventure, including parts of the official game flow.
[*] A mysterious room
[*] Mini-themed levels with a "relatively friendly" difficulty, 
[*] Several unique creatures (and characters)
[*] Fun special levels that can be replayed for score resets
[*] Implementation of Japanese voice acting
[/list]


Looking forward to meeting you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936407/1a404d3d9aa74d8b4a410df6d3d84b83a24c816a.png[/img]
